scope: Standing Chinatown Sri Mariamman Temple complex with its street gopuram, main hall, four western sanctuary domes, walled forecourt and attached auxiliary roofs.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Singapore National Heritage Board documents standing five-tier tower, painted figures, cow figures on the compound walls and vimanam over the sanctuaries.
National Library study documents two rows of trefoil arches in the main hall, heavy double timber entry and four western vimanam.
Owner documents two round windows beside the street gate.
The Urban Redevelopment Authority credits the current conservation project for the historic monument.

next: Build the five-tier street gopuram, mandapam, compound and shrine roofs from the current surveyed controls and documented architectural forms.
